prompts.marketPrice:
Look up market prices for these products. 
IMPORTANT: If you do not have direct internet access to look up live links, DO NOT PROVIDE INVENTED OR DEAD LINKS. Only give realistic estimates based on your knowledge. Never give fake URLs.
Do NOT use the internal "verify_price" function/tool because there are several items.

Order items:
{{items}}

For each product: give the estimated average market price and say whether the price paid is fair, low or too high.
